new_return_checks.method: Independent OpenCascade solid intersection after analytic AABB screen
new_return_checks.limits: Changed KSS vs drawn parts and cabinet vs stand/enclosure. Known original machine conflicts unchanged. Weld/contact tolerances, continuous motion, chip/fluid transport, strength, seals and safety not proven.

door_checks.method: OpenCascade solid intersections after conservative AABB screening
door_checks.limits: Nine samples. All drawn stationary model parts vs moving door; cross-segment pairs included. Intra-segment assembly/contact excluded. No continuous path, actual hardware, tolerances, deformation, seal, drainage or safety proof.

review: Author self-review; no independent reviewer/subagent was used.
limits: No Siemens NX execution. Required Sheet Metal conversion and actual saved PRT assembly unverified.
Collision checks apply to sharp-edged independent preforms and selected parts/poses only, not converted final parts or continuous motion.
Original machine attachment conflicts remain; no fabrication or operation approval.
Chip transport, filter mesh, seals, weld joints, clogging/overflow, coolant flow, thermal capacity and cabinet mounting strength are not validated.
Door coupling, force compensation and fall-prevention still need engineering.
